import.format_bookmarks_tooltip: Netscape format — standard export for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge
import.format_json_tooltip: Foldex's own format (preserves folders, tags, clicks)
import.format_hint_bookmarks: .html file exported from the browser (Chrome / Firefox / Safari / Edge).
import.drop_zone: Drag a file here or click to choose
import.export_bookmarks_tooltip: HTML that any browser can re-import
import.export_json_tooltip: Foldex's own JSON (preserves folders, tags, clicks)
import.mode_skip_desc: Keep existing; import only new. {{count}} links will be skipped.
import.mode_duplicate_desc: Try to import everything. Links with the same URL fall back to skip + warning (URL is UNIQUE).
import.mode_wipe_desc: DESTRUCTIVE per link. Deletes {{count}} existing link(s) (with their clicks/tags) and re-imports from the file. Links NOT in the file stay intact.
import.operation_locked: Import is running and cannot be canceled. This dialog will stay open until it finishes.

backup.card_body: Generates a ZIP with every table (tags, folders, links, notes, M:N, click_log) and every file from the bucket (screenshots + images).
backup.restore_dropzone: Drag the .zip or click to choose
backup.restore_file_invalid: File must be a foldex backup .zip.
backup.mode_skip_desc: Keep current; only add what's new. {{links}} links and {{tags}} tags will be skipped.
backup.mode_duplicate_desc: Renames conflicting tags to "name (2)"; folders always new. Links with the same URL fall back to skip (URL is UNIQUE).
backup.mode_wipe_desc: DESTRUCTIVE. Erases ALL current links, notes, tags, folders, clicks and files; restores with original IDs preserved.
backup.operation_locked: Restore is running and cannot be canceled. This dialog will stay open until it finishes.

stats.section_clicks_empty: No clicks in the last 60 days
stats.no_data: No data yet — click some links via /go/:id to populate.

errors.tag_name_taken: A tag with that name already exists.

errors_boundary.title: The page crashed while rendering
errors_boundary.body: The error is logged in the browser console. Reloading usually resolves it if it was caused by transient state; if it comes back, it's a bug.

settings.master_desc: A recovery password that can reset any folder's password if you forget it. Store it somewhere safe — there is no other way to recover a locked folder.
settings.master_too_short: Master password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.save_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.locked_desc: Reset a folder's password with the master password if you have forgotten it, then set a new one.
settings.master_hint_help: Shown to help you recall the master password. Must not be the password itself.
settings.master_hint_equals: The reminder must not be the same as the password.
settings.master_hint_placeholder_keep: Leave blank to keep the current one
settings.remove_explain: The folder will be left with no password (unprotected). Enter the master password to confirm.
settings.reset_explain: Enter the master password to clear the password, then set a new one.
settings.tile_account_desc: Name, e-mail, password and the Google sign-in link.
settings.tile_security_desc: Authenticator app, recovery codes and the login second factor.
settings.tile_tokens_desc: Tokens for the browser extension and other clients.
settings.tile_master_desc: The recovery password that resets locked folders.
settings.tile_locked_desc: Reset folder passwords with the master password.
settings.tile_import_desc: Bookmarks in, bookmarks out, full backups.
settings.tile_stats_desc: Clicks, top hosts and top links.
settings.tile_admin_users_desc: Accounts, roles, invites and password recovery.
settings.tile_profile_desc: Your name, e-mail, role and sign-out.
settings.page_lede: Everything that governs your base: account, security, people and permissions. Each card opens a dedicated panel.
settings.promo_desc: Takes two minutes and protects every way into your base.

auth_login.title: Sign in to Foldex
auth_login.subtitle: Your bookmarks, notes and folders — right where you left them.

auth_setup.title: Create the administrator account
auth_setup.subtitle: This is the first account on this instance. It becomes the administrator and adopts any existing content.

auth_invite.title: Activate your account
auth_invite.subtitle: Choose a password to finish setting up your Foldex account.
auth_invite.email_locked: This address comes from your invitation and cannot be changed.
auth_invite.invalid_title: This invitation is no longer valid
auth_invite.invalid_body: The link may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask an administrator to send a new one.

auth_marketing.title: Everything you save, in one place you control.
auth_marketing.point_organize: Nestable folders, tags and full-text search across links and notes.
auth_marketing.point_monitor: Watch any page for changes and get a push notification.
auth_marketing.point_private: Your data stays on your server. Every account sees only its own.

auth_errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth_errors.already_configured: This instance already has an account. Reload the page to sign in.
auth_errors.email_taken: That e-mail address is already registered.
auth_errors.password_too_short_one: The password must be at least {{count}} character.
auth_errors.password_too_short_other: The password must be at least {{count}} characters.
auth_errors.password_too_long: The password is too long (maximum 72 bytes).
auth_errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth_errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth_errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_errors.oauth_not_linked: We could not sign you in with that Google account.
auth_errors.oauth_email_unverified: Google has not confirmed that address. Confirm it with Google and try again.
auth_errors.oauth_already_linked: That Google account is already linked to another user.
auth_errors.oauth_invite_mismatch: That invitation was issued to a different address.
auth_errors.oauth_invite_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid.
auth_errors.oauth_disabled: Google sign-in is not configured on this instance.
auth_errors.oauth_failed: Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.

auth_otp.title: Enter your code
auth_otp.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {{email}}.
auth_otp.email_sent: If a code could be sent, it is on its way to {{email}}.
auth_otp.expired: This sign-in attempt expired. Please sign in again.
auth_otp.locked_out: Too many incorrect codes. Please sign in again.
auth_otp.invalid_with_attempts_one: That code is not valid. {{count}} attempt left.
auth_otp.invalid_with_attempts_other: That code is not valid. {{count}} attempts left.

auth_forgot.title: Reset your password
auth_forgot.subtitle: Enter your e-mail address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.

auth_sent.title: Check your e-mail
auth_sent.subtitle: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.
auth_sent.body: The link expires in 30 minutes and can be used once. If nothing arrives, check your spam folder.

auth_reset.title: Set a new password
auth_reset.subtitle: Signing in everywhere else will be required again after this change.
auth_reset.link_invalid: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.

twofa.enroll_subtitle: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twofa.enroll_failed: Could not start the setup. Please try again.
twofa.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
twofa.cannot_scan: Cannot scan? Show the setup key
twofa.enter_code_hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your app to finish.
twofa.codes_subtitle: Each code works once, and this is the only time they are shown.
twofa.codes_ack: I have saved these codes somewhere safe.
twofa.section_desc: Require a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password.
twofa.disable_warning: Your recovery codes will be deleted too. Anyone with your password alone will be able to sign in.
twofa.disable_one_warning: Your other method stays on, so your recovery codes are kept.
twofa.email_unavailable: This instance cannot send e-mail, so e-mail codes are unavailable.
twofa.email_not_enrolled: E-mail is not set up as a second factor on this account.
twofa.enroll_choose_subtitle: Choose how you want to confirm it is you.
twofa.enroll_choose_hint: An authenticator app works without a network connection. E-mail codes need no extra app.
twofa.enter_mailed_hint: Enter the 6-digit code we e-mailed you.
twofa.code_accepts_mailed: You can use a code from your app, a mailed code, or a recovery code.

auth_verify.done_body: Thanks — this address is now confirmed.
auth_verify.invalid_title: This link is no longer valid
auth_verify.invalid_body: Confirmation links expire and can be used once. Request a new one from your account settings.
auth_verify.failed_body: The server could not be reached. The link is still valid — try again in a moment.

auth_convert.title: Confirm your password
auth_convert.subtitle: {{email}} already has a Foldex account with a password.
auth_convert.warning: Confirming links this Google account and REMOVES your password. From then on you sign in with Google only, and every other session is signed out.
auth_convert.submit: Link Google and remove my password

account.section_desc: Your password and your linked accounts.
account.password_off: This account has no password — it signs in with Google.
account.password_why: Set a password so you can sign in without Google, and so you can disconnect it later.
account.password_set_done: Password set. Other sessions were signed out.
account.password_already_set: This account already has a password. Use the change-password form.
account.password_required_first: Set a password before disconnecting Google.
account.google_only_note: This account signs in with Google only. Set a password above before disconnecting it.
account.link_desc: Confirm your current credentials before leaving for Google. This prevents a stolen session from adding a new way into your account.

tokens.section_desc: For the browser extension and for scripts. A token reads and writes your links and notes; it cannot change your password, manage users or download a backup.
tokens.created_warning: This is the only time it is shown. Foldex stores only a hash, so it cannot be shown again.
tokens.revoke_message: Anything using “{{name}}” will stop working immediately.
tokens.too_many: Revoke an existing token before creating another.
tokens.invalid_name: Give the token a short name so you can recognise it later.

admin.invites_desc: Foldex is invite-only. Anyone you invite gets their own private library — you cannot see their links or notes, and they cannot see yours.
admin.delete_message: Everything {{email}} saved — links, notes, folders, tags and files — is deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
admin.reset_message: A single-use link will be sent only to the verified mailbox for {{email}}. Their password and sessions stay unchanged until they choose a new password.
admin.recovery_sent: A recovery link was sent to {{email}}
admin.recovery_sent_detail: No password or token was shown here. The account owner must use their verified mailbox and choose the new password.
admin.err_last_admin: This is the last active administrator.
admin.err_self_target: You cannot do that to your own account.
admin.err_smtp_required: Configure SMTP before sending administrator recovery links.
admin.err_mail_unavailable: The mail server did not accept the recovery message. No credential was changed.
admin.err_recovery_unavailable: The target account must be active and have a verified e-mail address.
admin.role_admin_scope: Manages people and reads the audit trail
admin.role_editor_scope: Creates and organizes their own library
admin.roles_unavailable: The role matrix could not be loaded.
admin.card_users_desc: Create, suspend and transfer accounts on this instance.
admin.card_roles_desc: The RBAC matrix the server actually enforces.
admin.card_invites_desc: E-mail invitations, entry links and validity.
admin.card_policy_desc: Minimum length, code lifetime and who may join with Google.
admin.card_audit_desc: Sign-ins, failures, role changes and invitations.
admin.audit_unavailable: The audit log could not be loaded.
admin.policy_unavailable: The policy could not be loaded.
admin.policy_read_only: Only the owner can change these rules.
admin.policy_invalid: Some value is outside the allowed range.
admin.policy_floor_hint: These are floors: the instance never accepts anything weaker than its built-in minimum.
admin.policy_domains_hint: One per line. Leave empty to allow any domain. Matching is exact — a subdomain is not the domain.
admin.policy_auto_provision_desc: A Google user from an allowed domain gets an account on first sign-in. Off by default: with it on, this instance stops being invite-only.
admin.transfer_message: {{email}} becomes the owner and you become an admin. Every session of both accounts is signed out, including yours. This cannot be undone without the new owner's help.
admin.err_owner_immutable: The owner's role and status change only by transferring the instance.
admin.err_forbidden_role: Your role does not allow this action.
admin.err_target_not_active: Ownership can only pass to an active account.
admin.err_not_owner: Only the current owner can transfer the instance.
admin.roles_count_one: One role in use on this instance.
admin.roles_count_other: {{count}} roles in use on this instance.
admin.policy_admin_factor_hint: An admin whose only factor is e-mail is weaker: the mailbox is already the recovery channel, so both steps depend on it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name_placeholder: How your name appears across Foldex
profile.name_hint: Shown on your avatar menu and to administrators. Your e-mail cannot change — it is the account identity.
profile.err_name_too_long: The name must be at most 120 characters.
profile.logout_all_message: Every session of this account — including this one — will be signed out. Tokens are kept.
profile.locale_hint: Used for the e-mails this instance sends you — sign-in codes, reset links and notifications.
profile.err_locale_unsupported: That language is not one this instance ships.
